texts.value: Ubiquitin-binding adapter that links a subset of NEDD8-associated cullin ring ligases (CRLs) to the segregase VCP/p97, to regulate turnover of their ubiquitination substrates

The UBA domain is required for binding ubiquitinated-protein substrates
